title: The leak scan misses a key block behind a list-bullet prefix or with a header that has no space after its colon
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits flags an EC or PGP key block whose lines carry a '* ' or '- ' list-bullet prefix, and one whose header is written Comment:Alice with no space, as it flags one behind '> '

run: import base64,os,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon;d='-'*5;b=base64.b64encode(os.urandom(96)).decode();nl=chr(10);hit=lambda t:any(k=='secret' for k,_ in kbcommon.leak_hits(t));a=d+'BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY'+d;c={'star':a+nl+'* '+b[:64],'dash':a+nl+'- Comment: a'+nl+'- '+b[:64],'nospace':d+'BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK'+d+nl+'Comment:Alice'+nl+nl+b[:64]};m=[k for k,v in c.items() if not hit(v)];print('passing:',m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)

clauses.clause: kbcommon.leak_hits flags an EC or PGP key block whose lines carry a '* ' or '- ' list-bullet prefix
one whose header is written Comment:Alice with no space, as it flags one behind '> '

notes: Found 2026-10-23 by the third SP-evq2flqc fresh review on 86d646801; not checked against the earlier shapes. Same gap list as BG-h6y5s45w (/// and //! prefixes): one fix may cover both.
